#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

long long pow_mod(long long a, long long n, long long mod) {
    long long ret = 1;
    for (; n > 0; n >>= 1) {
        if (n & 1) ret = ret * a % mod;
        a = a * a % mod;
    }
    return ret;
}

vector<vector<int>> enumFIF(int n, int mod) {
    vector<int> f(n + 1), invf(n + 1);
    f[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        f[i] = (long long)f[i - 1] * i % mod;
    }
    long long a = f[n], b = mod, p = 1, q = 0;
    while (b > 0) {
        long long c = a / b;
        long long d = a;
        a = b;
        b = d % b;
        d = p;
        p = q;
        q = d - c * q;
    }
    invf[n] = (int)((p % mod + mod) % mod);
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        invf[i] = (long long)invf[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod;
    }
    return {f, invf};
}

long long C(int n, int r, int mod, const vector<vector<int>>& fif) {
    if (n < 0 || r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
    return (long long)fif[0][n] * fif[1][r] % mod * fif[1][n - r] % mod;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, K, L;
    cin >> n >> K >> L;
    const int mod = 998244353;
    auto fif = enumFIF(10000, mod);
    vector<long long> muls(n + 1, 0);
    for (int i = K; i <= n; i++) {
        long long m = C(n, i, mod, fif);
        for (int j = i; j <= n; j++) {
            long long val = m * C(n - i, n - j, mod, fif) % mod;
            if ((j - i) % 2 == 1) val = (mod - val) % mod;
            muls[j] = (muls[j] + val) % mod;
        }
    }
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = K; i <= n; i++) {
        long long term = pow_mod(2, i, mod) * (long long)fif[0][i] % mod * (long long)fif[0][i] % mod;
        term = term * fif[1][2 * i + 1] % mod * muls[i] % mod;
        ans = (ans + term) % mod;
    }
    cout << (ans * L) % mod << "\n";
    return 0;
}
